mnd9:58.4: samo visesī udavā nihīno yo maññati so vivadetha tena.
mnd9:59.1: tīsu vidhāsu avikampamāno samo visesīti na tassa hotīti -
mnd9:59.2: yassetā tisso vidhā pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭippassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhā, so tīsu vidhāsu na kampati na vikampati; avikampamānassa puggalassa ‘sadisohamasmī’ti vā ‘seyyohamasmī’ti vā ‘hīnohamasmī’ti vā;
mnd9:59.3: na tassa hotīti na mayhaṃ hotīti -
mnd9:63.2: ‘brāhmaṇo’ti sattannaṃ dhammānaṃ bāhitattā brāhmaṇo …pe… asito tādī pavuccate sa brahmā;
mnd9:63.4: ‘sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ, moghamañña’nti brāhmaṇo kiṃ vadeyya? kiṃ katheyya? kiṃ bhaṇeyya? kiṃ vohareyya?
mnd9:63.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā, idameva saccaṃ, moghamañña’nti brāhmaṇo kiṃ vadeyya? kiṃ katheyya? kiṃ bhaṇeyya? kiṃ dīpayeyya? kiṃ vohareyya cāti
mnd9:64.2: brāhmaṇo ‘mayhaṃva saccaṃ, tuyhaṃ musā’ti kena mānena kāya diṭṭhiyā kena vā puggalena kalahaṃ kareyya? bhaṇḍanaṃ kareyya? viggahaṃ kareyya? vivādaṃ kareyya? medhagaṃ kareyya:
mnd9:65.2: ‘yasmi’nti yasmiṃ puggale arahante khīṇāsave ‘sadisohamasmī’ti māno natthi, ‘seyyo hamasmī’ti atimāno natthi; ‘hīnohamasmī’ti omāno natthi, na santi na saṃvijjati nūpalabbhati, pahīnaṃ samucchinnaṃ vūpasantaṃ paṭippassaddhaṃ abhabbuppattikaṃ ñāṇagginā daḍḍhanti -
mnd9:66.2: so kena mānena kāya diṭṭhiyā kena vā puggalena vādaṃ paṭisaṃyujeyya, paṭicareyya. kalahaṃ kareyya, bhaṇḍanaṃ kareyya, viggahaṃ kareyya, vivādaṃ kareyya. medhagaṃ kareyya:
mnd9:70.1: “atha kho haliddakānī gahapati yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mnd9:70.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho haliddakānī gahapati āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca:
mnd9:72.1: imassa nu kho bhante kaccāna! bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo?”ti.
mnd9:73.1: “rūpadhātu ko gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. rūpadhāturāgavinibaddhañca pana viññāṇaṃ ‘okasārī’ti vuccati.
mnd9:73.4: saṅkhāradhātu kho gahapati, viññāṇassa oko, saṅkhāradhāturāgavinibaddhañca pana viññāṇaṃ ‘okasārī’ti vuccati.
mnd9:74.2: rūpadhātuyā kho gahapati yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
mnd9:74.7: viññāṇadhātuyā kho gahapati, yo chando yogo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
mnd9:76.2: rūpanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā kho gahapati tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā
mnd9:76.8: dhammanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā kho gahapati, tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
mnd9:77.2: idha gahapati, ekacco bhikkhu gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati: sahanandī sahasokī, sukhitesu sukhito, dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā voyogaṃ āpajjati.
mnd9:77.3: evaṃ kho gahapati! gāme santhavajāto hoti.
mnd9:78.1: kathañca gahapati, gāme na santhavajāto hoti?
mnd9:78.2: idha gahapati, ekacco bhikkhu gihīhi asaṃsaṭṭho viharati: na sahanandī na sahasokī, na sukhitesu sukhito, na dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu na attanā voyogaṃ āpajjati.
mnd9:78.3: evaṃ kho gahapati! gāme na santhavajāto hoti.
mnd9:79.2: idha gahapati, ekacco bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigata chando avigata pemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
mnd9:79.3: evaṃ kho gahapati, kāmehi aritto hoti.
mnd9:80.2: idha gahapati, ekacco bhikkhu kāmesu vītarāgo hoti vigatachando vigatapemo vigatapipāso vigatapariḷāho vigatataṇho.
mnd9:80.3: evaṃ kho gahapati! kāmehi ritto hoti.
mnd9:81.2: idha gahapati, ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
mnd9:81.7: evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhāna’nti tattha nandiṃ samannāneti.
mnd9:82.2: idha gahapati, ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti:
mnd9:82.3: ‘evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhāna’nti na tattha nandiṃ samannāneti.
mnd9:82.7: evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhāna’nti na tattha nandiṃ samannāneti.
mnd9:83.1: kathañca gahapati, kathaṃ viggayha janena kattā hoti?
mnd9:83.2: idha gahapati, ekacco bhikkhu evarūpaṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti:
mnd9:83.3: ‘na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi …pe… nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī’ti.
mnd9:83.4: evaṃ kho gahapati, kathaṃ viggayha janena kattā hoti.
mnd9:84.1: kathañca gahapati, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kattā hoti?
mnd9:84.2: idha gahapati, ekacco bhikkhu na evarūpaṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti:
mnd9:84.5: evaṃ kho gahapati, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kattā hoti.
mnd9:84.6: iti kho gahapati, yantaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā aṭṭhakavaggiye māgandiya pañhe:
mnd9:86.1: imassa kho gahapati, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti.
mnd9:90.3: vivittoti kāyaduccaritena ritto vivitto pavivitto; vacīduccaritena -

mnd9:91.8: āgu vuccanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā.

mnd9:95.6: arahattamaggena ye kilesā pahīnā, te kilese na puneti, na pacceti, na paccāgacchati,

mnd9:96.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā, idameva saccaṃ, moghamañña’nti vadeyya katheyya bhaṇeyya dīpayeyya vohareyyāti -
mnd9:97.1: elambujaṃ kaṇṭakaṃ vārijaṃ yathā jalena paṅkena ca nūpalittanti
mnd9:97.2: ‘elaṃ’ vuccati udakaṃ. ‘ambujaṃ’ vuccati padumaṃ, ‘kaṇṭako’ vuccati kharadaṇḍo. ‘vāri’ vuccati udakaṃ. ‘vārijaṃ’ vuccati padumaṃ vārisambhavaṃ. ‘jalaṃ’ vuccati udakaṃ. ‘paṅko’ vuccati kaddamo.
mnd9:97.3: yathā padumaṃ vārijaṃ vārisambhavaṃ jalena ca paṅkena ca na lippati, na saṃlippati nūpalippati, alittaṃ asaṃlittaṃ, anupalittanti -
mnd9:97.4: “elambujaṃ kaṇṭakaṃ vārijaṃ yathā jalena paṅkena ca nūpalittaṃ.”
mnd9:98.1: evaṃ munī santivādo agiddho kāme ca loke ca anūpalittoti
mnd9:98.4: monaṃ vuccati ñāṇaṃ …pe… saṅgajālamaticca so muni.
mnd9:98.5: santivādoti santivādo muni tāṇavādo lenavādo saraṇavādo abhayavādo accutavādo amatavādo nibbānavādoti -
mnd9:98.9: yo rāgo sārāgo …pe… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ;
mnd9:98.10: yassa so gedho pahīno samucchinno vūpasanto paṭippassaddho abhabbuppattiko ñāṇagginā daḍḍho, so vuccati agiddho.
mnd9:98.11: so rūpe agiddho; sadde - gandhe - rase - phoṭṭhabbe - kule - gaṇe - āvāse - lābhe - yase pasaṃsāya - sukhe - cīvare - piṇḍapāte - senāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāre - kāmadhātuyā - rūpadhātuyā - arūpadhātuyā - kāmabhave - rūpabhave - arūpabhave - nevasaññānāsaññābhave - ekavokārabhave - catuvokārabhave pañcavokārabhave atīte - anāgate - paccuppanne - diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu agiddho agathito amucchito anajjhopanno vītagedho vigatagedho cattagedho vantagedho muttagedho paṭinissaṭṭhagedho vītarāgo vigatarāgo cattarāgo vantarāgo muttarāgo pahīnarāgo paṭinissaṭṭharāgo nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharatīti -
mnd9:99.6: loketi apāyaloke manussaloke devaloke khandhaloke dhātuloke āyatanaloke;
mnd9:99.11: muni taṇhālepaṃ pahāya diṭṭhilepaṃ paṭinissajitvā kāme ca loke ca na lippati, na palippati, na upalippati. alitto asaṃlitto anupalitto nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharatīti -
mnd9:99.12: evaṃ munī santivādo agiddho kāme ca loke ca anūpalitto.’
mnd9:102.2: sa mānameti na hi tammayo so,
mnd9:103.1: na vedagū diṭṭhiyā na mutiyā sa mānametīti -
mnd9:103.4: ‘vedaṃ’ vuccati catusu maggesu ñāṇaṃ, paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīmaṃsā vipassanā sammā diṭṭhi.
mnd9:103.5: tehi vedehi jātijarāmaraṇassa antagato antappatto koṭigato koṭippatto pariyantagato pariyantappatto vosānagato vosānappatto tāṇagato tāṇappatto lenagato lenappatto saraṇagato saraṇappatto abhayagato abhayappatto accutagato accutappatto amatagato amatappatto nibbānagato nibbānappatto vedānaṃ vā antaṃ gatoti vedagū. vedehi vā antaṃ gatoti vedagū. sattannaṃ dhammānaṃ viditattā vedagū: sakkāyadiṭṭhi viditā hoti, vicikicchā viditā hoti, sīlabbataparāmāso vidito hoti, rāgo vidito hoti, doso vidito hoti, moho vidito hoti, māno vidito hoti, viditā’ssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā.
mnd9:105.1: na diṭṭhiyāti - tassa dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭippassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni.
mnd9:105.2: so diṭṭhiyā na yāyati, na nīyati, na vuyhati, na saṃharīyati, napi taṃ diṭṭhigataṃ sārato pacceti. na paccāgacchatīti -
mnd9:105.4: na mutiyā sa mānametīti - mutarūpena vā paratoghosena vā mahājanasammutiyā vā mānaṃ neti, na upeti, na upagacchati, na gaṇhāti, na parāmasati, nābhinivisatīti -
mnd9:106.1: na hi tammayo soti - na taṇhāvasena na diṭṭhivasena tammayo hoti tapparamo tapparāyaṇo;
mnd9:106.2: yato taṇhā ca diṭṭhi ca māno ca assa pahīnā honti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, ettāvatā na tammayo hoti, na tapparamo, na tapparāyaṇoti -
mnd9:107.2: ‘na kammunā’ti puññābhisaṅkhārena vā apuññābhiṅkhārena vā āneñjābhisaṅkhārena vā na yāyati, na nīyati, na vuyhati, na saṃharīyatīti -
mnd9:107.4: nopi sutena neyyoti sutasuddhiyā vā paratoghosena vā mahājanasammutiyā vā na yāyati, na nīyati, na vuyhati, na saṃharīyatīti -
mnd9:108.7: taṇhūpayassa pahīnattā diṭṭhūpayassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā so nivesanesu anūpanīto anupalitto anupagato anajjhosito anadhimutto nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharatīti
mnd9:110.2: sa mānameti na hi tammayo so,
mnd9:111.3: saññaṃ ca diṭṭhiṃ ca ye aggahesuṃ
mnd9:112.2: yo samathapubbaṅgamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti, tassa ādito upādāya ganthā vikkhambhitā honti, arahatte patte arahato ganthā ca mohā ca nīvaraṇā ca, kāmasaññā vyāpādasaññā vihiṃsāsaññā diṭṭhisaññā ca pahīnā honti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāti -
mnd9:113.2: yo vipassanāpubbaṅgamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti, tassādito upādāya mohā vikkhambhitā honti, arahatte patte arahato mohā ca ganthā ca nīvaraṇā ca kāmasaññā vyāpādasaññā vihiṃsāsaññā diṭṭhisaññā ca pahīnā honti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāti -
mnd9:114.1: saññaṃ ca diṭṭhiṃ ca ye aggahesuṃ te ghaṭṭayantā vicaranti loketi
mnd9:114.2: ye saññaṃ gaṇhanti kāmasaññaṃ vyāpādasaññaṃ vihiṃsāsaññaṃ, te saññāvasena ghaṭṭenti saṃghaṭṭenti.
mnd9:114.3: rājānopi rājūhi vivadanti. khattiyāpi khattiyehi vivadanti. brāhmaṇāpi brāhmaṇehi vivadanti. gahapatikāpi gahapatīhi vivadanti, mātāpi puttena vivadati. puttopi mātarā vivadati. pitāpi puttena vivadati. puttopi pitarā vivadati. bhātāpi bhātarā vivadati. bhaginīpi bhaginiyā vivadati. bhātāpi bhaginiyā vivadati. bhaginīpi bhātarā vivadati. sahāyopi sahāyena vivadati.
mnd9:114.4: te tattha kalahaviggahavivādamāpannā aññamaññaṃ pāṇīhipi upakkamanti. leḍḍūhipi upakkamanti. daṇḍehipi upakkamanti. satthehipi upakkamanti.
mnd9:114.5: te tattha maraṇampi nigacchanti. maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ.
mnd9:114.7: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā’ti vā, te diṭṭhivasena ghaṭṭenti saṃghaṭṭenti. satthārato satthāraṃ ghaṭṭenti. dhammakkhānato dhammakkhānaṃ ghaṭṭenti. gaṇato gaṇaṃ ghaṭṭenti. diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhiṃ ghaṭṭenti. paṭipadāya paṭipadaṃ ghaṭṭenti. maggato maggaṃ ghaṭṭenti.
mnd9:115.1: athavā, te vivadanti. kalahaṃ karonti. bhaṇḍanaṃ karonti. viggahaṃ karonti vivādaṃ karonti. medhagaṃ karonti:
mnd9:115.5: abhisaṅkhārānaṃ appahīnattā gatiyā ghaṭṭenti. niraye ghaṭṭenti, tiracchānayoniyā ghaṭṭenti. pettivisaye ghaṭṭenti. manussaloke ghaṭṭenti. devaloke ghaṭṭenti. gatiyā gatiṃ upapattiyā upapattiṃ paṭisandhiyā paṭisandhiṃ bhavena bhavaṃ saṃsārena saṃsāraṃ vaṭṭena vaṭṭaṃ ghaṭṭenti saṃghaṭṭenti. ghaṭṭentā, caranti, vicaranti viharanti irīyanti vattenti pālenti yapenti yāpenti.
mnd9:115.7: ‘saññañca diṭṭhiñca ye aggahesuṃ te ghaṭṭayantā vicaranti loke.’
mnd9:117.3: saññaṃ ca diṭṭhiṃ ca ye aggahesuṃ
